notes: 'This day' at t006 has no demonstrative morpheme, so the article s006 takes the determiner; 'that place' and 'this day' later in the verse do have one, so there the articles are unrepresented (rule 41).
'the name of that place' matches rule 41's own worked example `שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא`: 'the name' to the construct, 'that' to the demonstrative pronoun, nothing to either article.
`מֵעֲלֵי` is split at s012/s013 ('from off'), each morpheme holding a word of its own; the same split is taken at v.15 s011/s012, so the chapter is internally consistent.
